exit 0
--- stdout
Generate the autocompletion script for powershell.
To load completions in your current shell session:
liza completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression
To load completions for every new session, add the output of the above command
to your powershell profile.
Usage:
liza completion powershell [flags]
Flags:
-h, --help help for powershell
--no-descriptions disable completion descriptions
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
